get_dataset_class: get the dataset class by name using get_dataset_class to instantiate a domain generalization dataset
num_environments: get the number of environments for a dataset by calling num_environments with the dataset name
ColoredMNIST: create a ColoredMNIST dataset with color-label spurious correlations for domain generalization experiments
RotatedMNIST: create a RotatedMNIST dataset with images rotated at different angles across environments
MultipleEnvironmentImageFolder: build a multiple environment image folder dataset from directory subfolders with optional data augmentation
